scene: The brass key opens a secret tunnel hub.
picture: Side view along a flat stone tunnel floor. On the far left, a metal book cart lift stands open. You stand left of centre in your straw hat and red poncho with guitar. At centre, a parked bicycle rickshaw awaits with a driver. On the far right hangs a glowing carnival gondola.
shown: A metal book cart lift on the far left with open brass gates.
A yellow bicycle rickshaw parked at centre with a waiting robotic driver.
A glowing carnival ferris wheel gondola hanging open on the far right.
